concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Keep concept tall near-vertical irregular resistant rock core and low eroded apron, remove excessive regular parallel pillar texture. Use uneven diameter, nonuniform joint facets and asymmetrical shoulders/crown; no perfect polygon cylinder. Make base continuous with steep core without stacked exposed overlapping slab faces. Photo Beacon Rock has vegetation and water; omitted. NPS clearly identifies Beacon Rock as neck; do not rely on uncertain Elephant Tusk or Devils Tower classifications.
